checks: The isolated verifier passed after checking the source/tool/semantic and B4C dependency pins, exact 96-byte body, caller sites, and nine trace-model cases. I independently inspected the exact C-SKY listing: count is stored raw at +4 and shifted left 16 at +0x18; end is computed before the subsequent MMIO writes; each byte path polls mask 2 at +0x28, LDBI.B loads and post-increments, and ST.W writes the zero-extended byte to +0x60. Completion polls the full word at +0x20 until zero, then B4C runs and R0 returns that zero.

Caller path disassembly shows CEC and D38 pass R8 to both pointer/count, with ANDI 2 followed by a branch away when nonzero; at the reached send calls those values are therefore zero, so byte loads are skipped. D42 passes SP+4 and count 2. All three return values are ignored.
The clear-register calculation yields 0xA2000080 + 0x74 = 0xA20000F4. Setup/store order and register-frame behavior match the listing.
limitations: Nine cases are static trace models with controlled input/MMIO words, not live original-instruction C-SKY execution. B4C and physical controller behavior remain unresolved; both wait loops are unbounded. Conditional mapping only; no canonical admission.
